text.p: Close of play scores on the third day of four-day English County Championship cricket matches on Saturday:

At Trent Bridge: Kent beat Nottinghamshire by an innings and 105 runs. Nottinghamshire 216 and 119 (M.McCague 4-33). Kent 440 (M.Ealham 122, D.Fulton 94, P.Strang 73). Kent 24 points, Nottinghamshire 4.
At Ilford: Essex 297 and 312 (R.Irani 100, S.Law 76; R.Stemp 6-77). Yorkshire 334 and 270-8 (D Byas 89, D.Lehmann 81; P M Such 5-89).
At Cardiff: Glamorgan 597-8 declared (S.James 153, H.Morris 135, M.Maynard 134 not out, A Dale 73). Durham 345 (M.Foster 129, D.Boon 66; S.Watkin 4-73) and 142-4 (J.Morris 84 not out).

At Southampton: Warwickshire 631-7 dec (A.Moles 168, D.Hemp 138, T.Penney 86 not out, N.Knight 81, G.Welch 75). Hampshire 549-6 (M.Hayden 235 not out, S.Udal 117 not out, W.Kendall 76; G.Welch 4-119).
At Leicester: Lancashire 373 and 279-2 (M.Atherton 100 not out, J.Gallian 99, J.Crawley 61). Leicestershire 468 (N.Johnson 150, P.Nixon 96, V.Wells 95).
At Lord's: Middlesex 531 (J.Kallis 121, M.Ramprakash 111, M.Gatting 108, K.Brown 61 not out; J.Taylor 4-99). Northamptonshire 216 (K.Curran 89 not out; J.Hewitt 5-59) and 168-6.
At Worcester: Worcestershire 303 and 186-4 (P.Weston 65). Somerset 343 (R.Turner 83 not out, P.Hoilloway 61; D.Leatherdale 5-56).
At Oxford: Oxford University 234-8 declared (J.Fulton 50) and 123-5. Sussex 203-5 declared (T.Radford 58 not out).
